instruction: Use the drink-preference note on the Desktop and the customer reviews on the already-open Q Mixers Premium Ginger Ale page to decide whether it is a good fit. If it fits all the preferences, add it to the cart.
gt_steps: Open `drink_preferences.txt` and read the three preferences.
Review the customer-review text on the already-open Q Mixers Premium Ginger Ale page.
Determine that the reviews support all three preferences.
Add Q Mixers Premium Ginger Ale to the shopping cart.

parameters.command: powershell -NoProfile -Command "Set-Content -Path (Join-Path $env:USERPROFILE 'Desktop\drink_preferences.txt') -Value @('Ginger ale preferences:','- less sweet / not overly sweet','- noticeable ginger flavor','- enjoyable on its own, not only as a mixer')"
